kind: Sanitized recorded remote-head observations; no private canonical state or agent transcript

archiveVerification.verification: Previously independently streamed original local Git blobs and checkout copies; Git IDs, per-file and concatenation SHA256 values matched.

interpretation: Under ordinary Git connectivity, the successful recorded remote head identifies the archived commit/tree/blob chain. This is not a new remote request or proof of a fresh remote payload download.
limitations: The author's earlier destination/CONNECT 403 failures remain true and are not bypassed.
No current checkout copy has been removed by Main.
Post-removal retrieval and exact-byte verification remain required.
Removing current-tree copies does not shrink existing Git history or full clones.
No guarantee of permanent remote availability, shallow/no-Git retrieval, offline sdist payloads, or completed acceptance.
Any later merge must retain the archive-containing ancestor; no squash, force-push, history rewrite, or reference deletion is authorized.
